items.exampleEn: We have a math test tomorrow.

items.exampleZh: 科技讓我們的生活更輕鬆。

items.exampleEn: I use a computer at work.
I wrote a letter to my grandmother.
There are many rules at this school.
The teacher writes on the board.

items.exampleZh: 我最喜歡的科目是自然科學。

items.sentenceEn: Please write the rules on the board.

items.audioEn: Don't forget the test tomorrow. Read your notes tonight.
items.audioZh: 別忘了明天的考試，今晚要讀你的筆記。
items.questionZh: 說話者要你今晚做什麼？

items.sentenceZh: 數學是我最喜歡的科目。
電腦科技幫助我們學習。

items.stemEn: I write a ____ to my friend in Japan.
items.stemZh: 我寫一封信給在日本的朋友。

items.stemEn: The teacher writes the new words on the ____.
items.stemZh: 老師把新的單字寫在黑板上。

items.passageEn: Our school has new technology this year. Every classroom has a computer and a big whiteboard. The teachers put their notes on the internet, so we can read them at home. But there is one rule: no phones in class!
items.passageZh: 我們學校今年有了新科技。每間教室都有一台電腦和一面大白板。老師會把筆記放到網路上，所以我們在家也能讀。不過有一條規定：上課不能用手機！

referenceEn: I have an English test tomorrow.
I will have an English test tomorrow.
rubricZh: 「有考試」可用 have a test（English 前面的冠詞用 an）
未來確定的安排可用現在簡單式或 will（例如 I have、I will have）

items.promptZh: 我可以看一下你的筆記嗎？
referenceEn: Can I look at your notes?
rubricZh: 請求可寫，例如 Can I see…、Can I look at…、May I… 等
